### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Identity picker for the preselected provider line](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2739) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — In the `Create cluster` dialog, the cloud identity field lists the installation's AWS identities when the AWS provider line is preselected, instead of offering a free text field.
